high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from Narendra Modi, the Prime Minister of India, congratulating Thiru Rajinikanth Ji on completing 50 years in the world of cinema. The tweet reads: "Congratulations to Thiru Rajinikanth Ji on completing 50 glorious years in the world of cinema. His journey has been iconic, with his diverse roles having left a lasting impact on the minds of people across generations. Wishing him continued success and good health in the times to come." The tweet includes a photo of two men standing side by side. On the left is Thiru Rajinikan
